name: MENAValues
description: We introduce MENAValues, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate the cultural alignment and multilingual biases of large language models (LLMs) with respect to the beliefs and values of the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, an underrepresented area in current AI evaluation efforts. Drawing from large-scale, authoritative human surveys, we curate a structured dataset that captures the sociocultural landscape of MENA with population-level response distributions from 16 countries. To probe LLM behavior, we evaluate diverse models across multiple conditions formed by crossing three perspective framings (neutral, personalized, and third-person/cultural observer) with two language modes (English and localized native languages: Arabic, Persian, Turkish). reputation: A new benchmark aimed at cultural alignment and multilingual bias evaluation for MENA-region values, with early-stage adoption in the LLM evaluation community.
notes: Measures culturally sensitive value alignment across languages and framings; likely subject to prompt sensitivity and survey-label ambiguity rather than contamination concerns.
